content: ककुभ {%a.%} <ab>Ved.</ab> Distinguished, superior. .{@-भः@} .²1 A crooked piece of wood at the end of the lute. .²2 The tree Arjuna; ककुभसुरभिः शैलः <ls>U. 1. 33</ls>. .²3 A kind of goblin or evil spirit. .²4 One of the Rāgas or personified musical modes. .{@-भा@} .²1 Space; quarter. .²2 One of the Rāgiṇīs. .{@-भम्@} A flower of the Kuṭaja tree; कालक्षेपं ककुभसुरभौ पर्वते पर्वते ते (उत्पश्यामि)
